records.text: An authenticated anonymous source reported that Ben Shapiro was allegedly with Gary Javitch and an unidentified woman when Charlie Kirk was shot
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep amqTMimDr0A)

appearances.snippet: Regardless, I will still say allegedly because, of course, there was always room for misunderstanding. ... But the person that Ben (Ben Shapiro) was with has allegedly told various other people that he was with Ben (Ben Shapiro) when Charlie Kirk was shot. ... Now, we were not able to confirm that they were at breakfast or lunch. Only what came to us was that they were together. ... And that person is a man named Gary Javitch. Ben (Ben Shapiro) was allegedly with Gary Javitch and an as-of-yet unidentified woman when Charlie Kirk was shot.

verification.notes: The transcript says Owens's team authenticated an anonymous tipster but repeatedly qualifies the identification of Gary Javitch and an unidentified woman as alleged. Current searches found reporting that repeats Owens's claim but no primary record or independent witness corroborating the meeting. The anonymous source and claimed authentication cannot be independently assessed.

records.text: Candace Owens said Gary Javitch had been executive director of B'nai B'rith International for years, had served repeatedly as executive board chair, and received its inaugural President's Award in 2019
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: But most critically, what is something that you should know about Gary Javitch? He is—and he has been—the executive director of B'nai B'rith International for years. ... Anyway, back to Gary (Gary Javitch). He served on the B'nai B'rith International's board as their executive board chair in 2011, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019. ... He received the inaugural President's Award in 2019 for advancing the organization's mission.

verification.notes: B'nai B'rith records support Javitch's international executive-board service and 2019 President's Award, and other reporting identifies him as director of the Omaha lodge. However, official reports name Daniel Mariaschin—not Javitch—as B'nai B'rith International's executive vice president/CEO, so the statement incorrectly elevates a local director and board member to international executive director.

records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: More about Gary (Gary Javitch). His professional biography says that he served on the National Council of AIPAC. Gary (Gary Javitch) was the president of the Nebraska chapter of AIPAC. It also lists his twin brother David Javich as being on the board of AIPAC currently.

verification.notes: Public event material identifies Gary Javitch as Nebraska AIPAC chair/president and a National Council member. No reliable current source located in the search established that his twin brother David was then a current AIPAC board member. The Gary Javitch portion is supported; the David Javitch portion remains unverified.

records.text: Candace Owens said Ben Shapiro and his wife had for years donated a life-and-legacy amount to the Jewish Federation of Omaha and that Gary Javitch was involved with the organization as a host and donor
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, we were able to discover that Ben Shapiro and his wife have been donating a life and legacy amount to the Jewish Federation of Omaha, Nebraska. ... Raska for years. I know he has some ties to Omaha. I'm not really clear to what extent or why maybe he just likes it. But of course, Gary is involved with that organization as a host and a donor.

verification.notes: Jewish Federation of Omaha annual reports substantiate a Gary Javitch family endowment and thus his donor connection. The current search did not locate a reliable record establishing years of a specific Ben and Mor Shapiro Life & Legacy donation to the Omaha federation. The Javitch portion is supported; the Shapiro donation portion remains unverified.
